InterLink Labs is revolutionizing Web3 with cutting-edge updates! 🚀 Let’s unpack the latest from this AI-powered, human-centric blockchain project. Follow @digitalgold1979 and https://t.co/Kk3kt7l1rT for more! 🧬 #InterLinkLabs #ITLG
1/ App V3.2 is a Game-Changer! 📱
InterLink Network’s latest app update (V3.2) dropped with a slick UI, a new burning mechanism to maintain fairness, and QR code payments for crypto-to-fiat in Nigeria, Vietnam, Philippines, Brazil, and Mexico. No Visa needed! 💸
Download now: https://t.co/e2ERzCaKZj
#Web3 #CryptoPayments
2/ Explosive User Growth 🌍
InterLink just hit over 1M registered users, with 130,000 joining last week alone! Their Proof of Personhood and anti-deepfake facial recognition tech are building a trusted human network. 🤝
Check out @digitalgold1979’s take: https://t.co/aVbdTwzASK
Who’s in? Share your referral code! 👇 #HumanHash
3/ Dual-Token Powerhouse 💎
$ITLG and $ITL form a unique ecosystem. Mine $ITLG to earn $ITL, used by the InterLink Foundation as a strategic reserve. No conversions needed! Learn more from @digitalgold22 on YouTube: https://t.co/Kk3kt7l1rT
How’s your $ITLG stack looking? 📈 #CryptoMining
4/ QR Payments & Global Reach 🏦
InterLink’s QR payment system lets you pay bills with crypto in 5 countries, with more coming! Partnerships like @AEON_Community are expanding the ecosystem. Watch @digitalgold22’s breakdown: https://t.co/Kk3kt7l1rT
What’s your favorite use case? 💬 #InterLinkNetwork
5/ Spin to Win with Qihong’s Game 🎰
The new Qihong Spin Game lets you play and earn rewards! Plus, InterLink’s $4000 USDT video contest is live—create content about their Web3 vision for a chance to win. Details via @digitalgold1979: https://t.co/fa0DIKUGf7
Ready to spin or create? 🎥 #Web3Gaming
6/ Ambassador Program = Big Rewards 🌟
Join InterLink’s Ambassador Program to earn tokens by creating posts or videos about their mission. @digitalgold1979 is hyping it up! Early adopters get ecosystem updates first. Join via: https://t.co/e2ERzCaKZj
Who’s creating content? Tag us! 📹 #InterLinkAmbassador
7/ Bug Fixes in Progress 🛠️
Some users reported lags in V3.2, but InterLink’s team is on it with rapid fixes. Got feedback? Drop it in their Telegram (https://t.co/7boHGPQfVt) or reply to @digitalgold1979. Let’s shape Web3 together! 🔧
What’s your experience with the app? #InterLinkFeedback
8/ Vision for 1 Billion Users 🌐
InterLink Labs aims to onboard 1B real humans with their InterLink ID—a “global passport” for banking, healthcare, and crypto. Their AI and ZK-proof tech ensures privacy and security. Dive deeper with @digitalgold22: https://t.co/Kk3kt7l1rT
Are you ready for this future? 🚀 #Web3Vision
9/ Community Events & AMAs 🗣️
InterLink’s hosting seminars in Indonesia, Pakistan, and India to spread their Web3 mission. Missed their latest AMA? Catch up via @digitalgold1979’s posts or join the next one on Telegram: https://t.co/aER8IpMqnN
What questions do you have for InterLink? 🤔 #InterLinkAMA
10/ Why InterLink Stands Out ⭐
With Google Startup and AWS support, InterLink’s building a bot-free, human-centric blockchain. Their wallet now supports 23 chains (Omnichain)! @digitalgold1979 breaks it down: https://t.co/aVbdTwzASK
What’s your favorite feature—mining, payments, or ID? 🙌 #Decentralized
11/ Get Involved! 💬
From mining $ITLG to using QR payments, InterLink’s ecosystem is growing fast. Follow @digitalgold1979 and https://t.co/Kk3kt7l1rT for updates. Join with referral code 020494048: https://t.co/e2ERzCaKZj

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 26 August 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Metro Manila, Cavite and Bulacan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Batangas, Laguna and Rizal which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 10:53 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
